rules.statement: In a test project, when integration tests assert that a protocol endpoint marks its responses non-cacheable (`Cache-Control: no-store`, `Pragma: no-cache`), at least one test also asserts those headers on an error response from that route, not only on success responses.
rules.why: If only success responses are checked, a change that stops the no-store filter from running on error paths for those routes would still pass the integration suite. Error responses need the headers too.
rules.check: Look at new or changed integration tests for token, PAR, or similar endpoints that assert no-store headers. Check whether any of them asserts the headers on an error response (for example a 400 `invalid_request`) as well as on 200/201 responses.
